root_cause.text: The `rock_continue()` function in the isofs subsystem fails to validate that the Rock Ridge CE continuation extent block number (`rs->cont_extent`) is within the bounds of the mounted ISO 9660 volume size (`s_nzones`) before passing it to `sb_bread()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a bounds check `if ((unsigned)rs->cont_extent >= ISOFS_SB(rs->inode->i_sb)->s_nzones)` in `fs/isofs/rock.c` to reject out-of-range block numbers, and the CVE description notes that `rock_continue()` previously read `rs->cont_extent` verbatim and passed it to `sb_bread()` without checking if it was within the mounted volume.
